description: Ask whether a given GPU setup can run a model. Returns measured RigBase results when available; otherwise a VRAM-fit estimate clearly labelled as an estimate (weights arithmetic, not a measured speed). Advises against quants below Q4. Always includes source credit and URLs for measured rows.

gpu.description: GPU or system name, e.g. "RTX 3090", "RTX 5090", "DGX Spark", "Apple Silicon Mac".

quant.description: Optional quant for the estimate (default Q4_K_M). Avoid below Q4.

name: can_it_run
